_comment: Corpus v3, 2026-08-29. See docs/data_recipe_v3.md for the measurement behind every number here. Three changes from v2: web drops from 88% because the 82% of it that hand-reading found unusable is filtered out rather than repeated; textbook (opencsg chinese-cosmopedia) and wiki are new domains; the total falls 11.5B -> 4.5B because FineWeb-Edu's result is that filtering to their threshold reaches the same MMLU with 10x fewer tokens. Weights are set so that no domain repeats more than about once -- v2 ran the small domains 4-6 times over, which is not more data, it is the same data again.
_synthetic_cap: textbook is model-generated. It could supply the whole corpus (4.69B tokens available from 8 of 62 parquets) and deliberately does not: SmolLM2 uses Cosmopedia at ~11% against real web, and we have no instrument that could see the damage from overdosing it -- every multiple-choice benchmark we own sits at the 25% chance line. Real human text stays the plurality.
